payload.name: Search Related Activity Terms for Complete Item Lists
payload.description: When a question asks for a list of items connected to a named activity, use this to also search related contexts and avoid stopping after one item.
content: When asked for a list of items (such as music pieces) associated with a named activity, run at least one follow-up search using closely related terms of that activity (e.g., for yoga: meditation, relaxation, calming, mindfulness; for workouts: exercise, cardio, training) and synonyms of the named activity.
Inspect preference memories returned under those related terms for concrete named items, even when the memory does not mention the original activity explicitly.

If the question indicates multiple items (plural, 'pieces', 'songs', 'books', etc.), do not treat the first matching item as the complete answer; continue searching until no new distinct items appear or the retrieved evidence covers all asked items.

solves: When a question asks for a list of items (e.g., music pieces) associated with a named activity, retrieval often over-anchors on the exact activity and misses items stored under related contexts (e.g., meditation, relaxation), producing incomplete answers. This skill guides expanding the search to associated terms and continuing until the list is complete.
